preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and queries q are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10**6 for (_, _, w) in edges)
preconditions.description: All initial edge weights are between 1 and 10^6.
The last n-1 edges (indices n-1 to 2n-3) all point to node 1.

preconditions.expression: len(set(a for (a, _, _) in edges[n-1:])) == n - 1 and all(2 <= a <= n for (a, _, _) in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The sources of the last n-1 edges are distinct and cover all nodes from 2 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= 2 * n - 2 and 1 <= w <= 10**6 for (t, i, w) in queries if t == 1)
preconditions.description: Type 1 queries specify a valid edge index and a valid weight.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for (t, u, v) in queries if t == 2)
preconditions.description: Type 2 queries specify valid source and destination nodes.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == len([q for q in queries if q[0] == 2])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 queries.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == shortest_path_length(u, v, current_edges) for line, (t, u, v) in zip(output_lines, queries) if t == 2)
postconditions.description: Each output line corresponds to the shortest path length between u and v in the graph state at the time of the query, considering dynamic edge weight updates.
